paragraphs: He is mentioned in Yalkut Tehillim, remez 790. Hyman calls this a scribal error and says it should read Rabbi Yohanan bar Maria, as the statement is cited in Bereshit Rabbah at פ״יג־ה [13:5].

notes.text: Hyman proposes Yohanan bar Maria in place of Yohanan ben Pedaya. The final locator is printed פ״יג־ה, apparently chapter 13, section 5; its exact printed form remains to be checked.

The saved whole Yalkut Shimoni on Nach790 scalar attributes the rain teaching to R’ Yochanan ben Pedaya; the saved whole Torat Emet Bereshit Rabbah13:5 scalar has full Rabbi Yochanan bar Maria for the corresponding saying. Hyman owns the proposed error/correction. The abbreviated Pedaya occurrence is rendered R', while the explicit Rabbi in the named Maria parallel supports that alternate occurrence. Source פ״יג־ה and numerical תש״ץ remain visible; no original-reading or identity verdict is made.

The consulted scan of Hyman, volume II, printed p. 685, confirms the locator פ״יג־ה. The corresponding rain teaching appears in the consulted Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 790 under Yochanan ben Pedaya and in Bereshit Rabbah 13:5 under Rabbi Yochanan bar Marya. This verifies the parallel and supports reading the locator as 13:5; Hyman’s judgment that the former name is an error remains his own. It does not establish an authority identity or which reading is original. The earlier notes record the state of inspection before this scan and source comparison.
